title: Product Management!
description:
Product Management! 
Isn't it all that you can hear people talk about nowadays What the hell is it after all  
Don't worry, we were just as confused as you are when starting out.  
CEL BITS GOA and BGCC brings to you Product Management Hackathon - A competition 
designed just for people like you! 
Step into the shoes of a Product Manager for a day and see for yourself if this is the right 
career option for you or not! 
 
First Position: PM Internship interview + 1500 Rs cash prize + 15% Cohort discount + 
Surprise gift + Certificate. 
Second Position: 500 Rs cash prize + 10% Cohort discount + Surprise gift+ Certificate. 
Third Position: 5% Cohort discount + Kuku FM 1 year subscription+ Surprise gift+ 
Certificate. 
 
Prerequisites- None! Just your laptop and some curiosity! 
Date & Time: 16th 9-10pm, and 17th 10-11 am
